selector: sort frequencies descending (ties original feature index); keep prefix ending at largest adjacent drop; ties choose smallest prefix; if no positive gap retain all; descriptive heuristic not proof of separation
predictive_primary: QDA fixed reg_param=1e-6 tol=1e-10; standardization fitted on training folds
evaluation: All supervised selection rerun on each outer training fold (200 rows); 1000 bootstrap draws of training-fold size; same resamples across top-count variants; no tuning on outer validation
report_spread: per-repeat mean fold AUC and its SD/range; fold SD supplementary; paired repeat differences descriptive, no independence claim
scope: No new Kaggle submissions; no threshold tuning to improve results; all branches reported.
